## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why is it worth doing?

<!-- Tip: the "why" matters more than the "how". -->

## Proposed Solution

What you'd like to see. Be specific if you can — endpoints, UI changes,
config knobs, etc.

## Alternatives Considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why you picked your proposal.

## Mockups / Examples

Screenshots, API sketches, or links to similar features in other tools.

## Out of Scope

Anything you explicitly don't want this PR / issue to expand into.

## Willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I'll send a PR
- [ ] Yes, with guidance
- [ ] No, just discussing
